programs.title: The Nature of Things
programs.desc: Science is revealing the truth about "dad bods" and how having a child can dramatically affect the brains and bodies of men; real dad bods are less about the pudge and more about the smarts.

programs.title: Coven
programs.desc: Three millennial women explore what it means to identify as a witch in today's world, and set out to discover if the rituals, lore and sacred places of their ancestors can help them channel their gifts, confront their obstacles and claim their power.

programs.title: Arctic Vets
programs.desc: Snow leopard Batu suddenly stops breathing while Dr. Andrea performs surgery; in Yukon, an injured baby lynx is reunited with its family with the help of Dr. Chris and new intern Dr. Shannon.

programs.title: Arctic Vets
programs.desc: Dr. Whitney assesses rescued harbor seals with new intern vet Dr. Shannon at The Alaska Sea Life Center; at the Conservancy, tensions rise as a sandhill crane goes into distress while under sedation.

programs.title: Arctic Vets
programs.desc: Intern vet Dr. Shannon takes part in her first surgery at APC on an endangered snow leopard; new polar bear alert officer Chantal jumps into action to chase a polar bear out of town.

programs.title: Arctic Vets
programs.desc: Dr. Chris and the team perform emergency dental surgery on polar bear Aurora; Barkley the bison has a broken horn; an orphaned otter pup gets much-needed attention.
